name: ai-agent-office
description: A visual office where Claude and ChatGPT agents work tasks together.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
